review_candidates.description: Department: Engineering Location: Bristol, UK Compensation: £40,000 - £80,000 / year Description We’re building the UK's next generation engineering powerhouse, providing critical technology that strengthens national security and resilience. We specialise in turning advances in sensing, AI, and communications into operational capability for the edge, where connectivity may be degraded or denied. Our work focuses on accelerating the deployment of technology, improving decision-making for frontline teams, and protecting people and critical assets in demanding environments. Headquartered in Bristol, Rowden employs around 200 people and operates over 20,000 square feet of engineering and manufacturing facilities. We have a growing international footprint and are one of Europe’s fastest-growing engineering businesses. About the role We're looking for enthusiastic and proactive Engineers who are interested in joining our growing Infrastructure / DevOps team. At Rowden, you’ll be empowered to exploit the latest technologies, cloud services and toolchains to deliver secure, reliable, best-in-class information systems and machine learning services in the Defence, Security and Emergency sectors. You’ll work across software, infrastructure, and integration boundaries: automating, deploying, and improving complex systems. You’ll use cloud technologies, but you won’t be limited to them. Candidates must be eligible for SC clearance. More information about security clearance is available here: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/united-kingdom-security-vetting-clearance-levels Key areas of responsibility As an Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer at Rowden, you’ll join a growing team, focusing on the following key areas of responsibility: Building and managing cloud platforms to support ongoing projects. Creating reliable systems and services through automation and Infrastructure-as-Code. Partnering with development teams to improve their workflows through rigorous testing and release procedures. Providing expertise on networks, security and databases. Gathering and analysing metrics from operating systems and applications to assist in performance tuning and fault finding. Key skills, experience and behaviours Essential At least 3 years’ experience building/operating systems on cloud, virtualised, or on-prem infrastructure. Hands on Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform or CloudFormation, plus a configuration management and automation tool like Ansible. Able to build and deploy versioned containers into a container orchestration service. Some coding/scripting experience, comfortable in at least one of: Python, Golang, JavaScript, or Bash. Awareness of secure system design and best practice frameworks such as NCSC Cloud Security Principles or equivalent. Able to apply engineering thinking to improve reliability, security, and maintainability. Desirable (not essential) Practical understanding of compute, networking, storage, and/or identity management. Experience managing multi-account or multi-tenant environments. Experience deploying and configuring observability tools and platforms. Familiarity with GitOps practices. Experience configuring and using Linux systems. About you The ideal candidate will have a strong balance of technical skills, experience, and the behaviours that help you succeed in this role: You have a real interest in technology and make an effort to keep building your skills. You enjoy trying new ideas and tools, and you look for practical ways to apply them. You notice problems early, point them out, and help fix them before they grow. You bring energy and initiative; if you see something that isn’t working, you want to improve it. You keep up with new tools, GitHub projects, and technical blogs to stay informed. You think about how systems work as a whole - considering edge cases, failures, and how people use them. You work well with others and use your hands-on experience and problem-solving skills to help deliver high quality engineering across the company. Working at Rowden We are committed to building a flexible, inclusive, and enabling company. Our aim is to create a diverse team of talented people with unique skills, experience, and backgrounds, so please apply and come as you are! We also recognise the importance of flexible working and support this wherever we can. We typically operate a flexible, hybrid-working model, with an average 3 days in the office each week (dependent on the role). We welcome the opportunity to discuss flexibility, part-time working requirements and/or workplace adjustments with all our applicants. Rowden is a Disability Confident Committed company, and we actively encourage people with disabilities and health conditions to apply for our roles. Please let us know your requirements early on so that we can make sure you have everything you need up front to help make the recruitment process and experience as easy as possible. Finally, if you feel that you don’t meet all the criteria included above but have transferable skills and relevant experience, we’d still love to hear from you!

review_candidates.description: Senior Microsoft 365 Engineer | M365 SME & Migrations | Massachusetts / New England | Hybrid | $130,000 to $170,000 Base + Bonus Travel: Occasional client-site travel across New England We are partnering with a well-established technology consultancy and managed services provider to hire a Senior Microsoft 365 Engineer into its growing Microsoft Cloud practice. This role is specifically designed for a Microsoft 365 subject matter expert. Approximately 75-85% of your focus will be within the Microsoft 365 ecosystem, working extensively across Microsoft Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive and identity/security technologies. We are not looking for an infrastructure generalist whose experience happens to include Microsoft 365. Instead, we are seeking someone whose recent career has been centered around designing, administering, migrating and improving enterprise Microsoft 365 environments. You could currently be the Microsoft 365 SME within a large internal enterprise environment or already working within an MSP or consultancy. Either way, you should bring the technical depth and communication skills to operate as the senior M365 authority in front of demanding customer stakeholders. The Opportunity You will take ownership of sophisticated Microsoft 365 environments and projects for customers experiencing significant growth and technology change. A major focus will be supporting organisations through Microsoft 365 migrations, acquisitions, integrations and tenant changes, alongside designing and improving their wider collaboration, identity and security environments. This is a highly hands-on technical position, but you will also be expected to operate as a trusted advisor to customers. You should be equally comfortable troubleshooting a complex Entra ID or migration issue as you are leading a technical discussion with senior stakeholders. What You'll Be Doing Act as a senior Microsoft 365 SME across complex customer environments Design, deliver and support Microsoft 365 migrations, including tenant-to-tenant migrations, consolidations, acquisitions and domain transitions Own migration projects through discovery, planning, technical design, execution, cutover, validation and post-migration support Work extensively across Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive Design and manage Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, authentication and identity security Work with technologies and approaches including Privileged Identity Management, passkeys and layered identity security Lead technical discovery sessions and workshops with customers Evaluate existing Microsoft 365 environments and provide recommendations around architecture, security, governance and best practice Handle complex escalations that require genuine subject matter expertise rather than general infrastructure support Automate Microsoft 365 administration and delivery using PowerShell and Microsoft Graph Produce technical designs, migration plans, runbooks and customer documentation Remain current with the evolving Microsoft 365 ecosystem and help customers adopt new capabilities appropriately What We're Looking For The most important requirement is depth of current Microsoft 365 experience. Ideally, you will bring: 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft 365 engineering experience A career that has remained heavily focused on Microsoft 365 in recent years Deep hands-on expertise across Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365 identity Strong experience with Conditional Access and modern authentication Experience supporting identity security capabilities such as Privileged Identity Management Significant hands-on experience delivering Microsoft 365 migrations Strong knowledge of Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online and OneDrive Experience with migration technologies such as BitTitan MigrationWiz, ShareGate, Quest, AvePoint or similar Strong PowerShell skills, with Microsoft Graph experience advantageous The ability to independently troubleshoot complex Microsoft 365 issues Strong customer-facing communication and presentation skills Relevant Microsoft certifications would be advantageous, but recent hands-on technical depth is more important than certifications alone. The Background We are particularly interested in speaking with two types of candidate: Enterprise Microsoft 365 SMEs: You may currently own or support Microsoft 365 within a large enterprise, acting as the internal specialist for collaboration, identity, migrations and the wider M365 environment. If you are looking for greater variety and the opportunity to apply that expertise across multiple organisations, this could be a compelling next step. Microsoft-focused MSP / Consulting Engineers: If you are already working within an MSP or consultancy, we are specifically looking for candidates who have specialised deeply in Microsoft 365, rather than engineers splitting their time evenly across networking, traditional infrastructure, virtualization and cloud technologies. Previous MSP experience is therefore advantageous but not essential. Genuine Microsoft 365 expertise is the priority. The Person Technical capability alone will not make someone successful in this position. You will be representing the organisation in front of sophisticated customers and senior stakeholders, so you need the confidence to own the room technically, explain complex Microsoft technologies clearly and provide credible recommendations. For candidates moving from an internal enterprise environment, this position will provide a faster-paced and more varied working environment. You will move between different customer priorities and projects, meaning adaptability, ownership and strong customer communication are particularly important. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is a strong opportunity for someone who has developed deep Microsoft 365 expertise and wants to remain hands-on and technically focused while gaining greater variety and visibility. You will benefit from: A role where Microsoft 365 is genuinely the primary technical focus Ownership of complex and business-critical M365 migrations Exposure to growing customer environments undergoing acquisitions and significant technology change The opportunity to apply your M365 expertise across multiple organisations High levels of customer and senior stakeholder exposure Company-funded Microsoft certifications and continued professional development The opportunity to establish yourself as a trusted senior SME within a growing Microsoft practice A culture where strong engineers have a genuine voice in technical direction and solution design Benefits Year-end bonus, typically targeted around 5-10% 401(k) with 3% Safe Harbor company contribution Approximately 95% employer-paid health insurance Dental and vision coverage Unlimited PTO Professional development and certification funding Flexible hybrid working Location The initial focus is on candidates based in Massachusetts and the wider New England region, with Massachusetts, New Hampshire, Rhode Island, Connecticut and Maine all potentially considered. The position operates on a flexible hybrid basis, with access to the Massachusetts office and occasional customer-site travel across the region. If Microsoft 365 has been the core of your career rather than one technology amongst many, and you enjoy combining deep technical problem-solving with migrations and customer engagement, we'd be interested in speaking with you.
